title: On Formal Counterfactual Explanations
abstract: arXiv:2611.22010v1 Announce Type: new  Abstract: Counterfactual explanations are often seen as counterfactual conditionals under closest-world semantics, requiring one to reason over all minimally distant counterexamples. In contrast, formal XAI typically relies on feature-based abductive explanations (AXps) and contrastive explanations (CXps), which admit efficient computation and a minimal hitting-set duality. This paper bridges these perspectives by (i) characterizing closest-world counterfactual explanations explicitly as a disjunctive normal form over all minimally distant counterexample instances, and (ii) introducing conjunctive counterfactual explanations (CFXps), a subclass of counterfactual antecedents restricted to conjunctions of feature literals that guarantee prediction change. The paper establishes structural results connecting CXps, AXps and CFXps: every CXp induces an AXp for its witness instance, and every CXp together with a witness AXp induces a CFXp whose support i

translated_abstract: 反事实解释通常被视为在最近世界语义下的反事实条件句，这需要对所有最小距离的反例进行推理。相比之下，形式化可解释人工智能（XAI）通常依赖于基于特征的溯因解释和对比解释，这两类解释支持高效计算并具有最小命中集对偶性。本文通过以下两种方式连接这两种视角：(i) 将最近世界反事实解释明确刻画为所有最小距离反例实例之上的析取范式；(ii) 引入合取反事实解释，这是反事实前件的一个子类，限制为能保证预测变化的特征文字的合取。论文建立了连接CXps、AXps与CFXps的结构性结果：每个CXp都为其见证实例诱导出一个AXp，并且每个CXp与一个见证AXp共同诱导出一个支持……（原文摘要在此处截断）
tldr: 本文将最近世界语义下的反事实解释刻画为析取范式，并提出合取反事实解释（CFXps）这一新概念，建立了CXps、AXps与CFXps之间的结构联系，从而架起了反事实解释与形式化XAI之间的桥梁。
en_tdlr: This paper bridges closest-world counterfactual explanations with formal XAI by characterizing them as disjunctive normal forms over minimally distant counterexamples and introducing conjunctive counterfactual explanations (CFXps), establishing structural connections among CXps, AXps, and CFXps.
